parameters.content:
## WF-02: User State Router

Routes by status + message type:
- NEW_USER → WF-21
- PRE_FORM_TEXT → WF-23
- DETAILS_FORM → WF-22
- PAYMENT_CONFIRM → WF-32
- PAYMENT_PENDING_TEXT → WF-30
- PAYMENT_SUBMITTED_TEXT → WF-31
- RELAY → WF-40
- POST_CONSULT_TEXT → WF-43

nodes.name: Non-Text Blocked?
nodes.notes: TRUE (blocked) is intentionally terminal — U2 already sent the block alert; no user reply on block. FALSE -> send the text-only deflection.

assignments.name: messageContent
assignments.value: This service supports text messages only. If you'd like to share a document, image, voice note or any other file, please email it to chinmay_astro@gmail.com along with your phone number and name. We'll get back to you as soon as possible.
